title: Paired affine form after appending two coordinates
statement: Let $r,k$ be natural numbers, let $x$ be a vector of length $r+2k$ over the field with two elements, and let $a,b$ lie in that field. The paired affine linear form with parameter $k+1$, evaluated on the vector formed by appending $a,b$ to $x$, equals the paired affine linear form with parameter $k$ evaluated on $x$, plus the sum of the coordinates of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: a and b are elements of F₂
